candidates.change_summary: Delete the if(intitalized)revert(); check, allowing MinSum to be changed after initialization.
Replace MinSum = _val; with MinSum = _val + 1; so that MinSum is always one more than the argument.
Delete the require(!locked_); check, removing reentrancy protection entirely.
Delete the locked_ = true; statement, so the modifier never locks and reentrancy is allowed.
Replace require(!locked_); with require(true);, effectively removing the reentrancy check.

Replace `if(intitalized)revert();` with `if(!intitalized)revert();` so SetMinSum reverts if not initialized instead of if initialized, allowing MinSum to be set to _val when initialized is true, changing the stored MinSum.
Replace `MinSum = _val;` with `MinSum = add_uint256(_val, 1);` so the stored MinSum is _val + 1 instead of _val.
Replace `MinSum = _val;` with `MinSum = sub_uint256(_val, 1);` so the stored MinSum is _val - 1 (asserting _val >= 1) instead of _val.
Replace `MinSum = _val;` with `MinSum = 0;` so the stored MinSum is always 0 regardless of _val.
Delete the `if(intitalized)revert();` guard, allowing MinSum to be set even after initialization, which can change the stored value.
Delete the `MinSum = _val;` assignment, so MinSum remains unchanged (default 0 or previous value) after the call.

Delete the modifier body contents so nonReentrant_ performs no checks and no lock, allowing SetMinSum to be called without reentrancy guard, which does not change the stored MinSum value directly but changes the behavior of the call (it succeeds where it would have reverted due to lock). This can lead to a different MinSum being set if a reentrant call occurs.

Replace `require(!locked_);` with `require(locked_);` so the modifier only allows reentrant calls, making SetMinSum revert on first call, but if called reentrantly, it can set MinSum where it would have previously reverted.
Drop the `nonReentrant_` modifier from SetMinSum, allowing it to be called without lock checks, which can lead to a different MinSum value being set during reentrancy.
